caption: Weather Station: explore, enable, configure
say: This is the Weather Station page for one project. First we explore it. Then we see how products are enabled, and how each one is configured.

caption: The answer: Danger, with recommended steps
say: The red strip is the answer: Danger, in words. Click View Recommended Steps to open the actions behind it.

caption: Actions in priority order
say: They come in priority order, and the first one is marked Do first.

caption: Details: verdict, data confidence, last update
say: Details opens the full verdict, with the data confidence and the time of the last update.

caption: Featured cards: heat index, work, rest and water
say: Below, the featured cards. The heat index card shows its band, and the work, rest and water cycle for the crew.

caption: Copy as image and Export (not clicked)
say: Copy as image copies your selected cards as a picture, to paste and share. And Export, at the top right, exports the weather data.

caption: Stations: click one to see its panel
say: On the right are the stations, each Online or Offline. Click a station to view it. A panel shows its identifier and the time of its last reading.

caption: The pencil renames a station (not clicked)
say: The pencil next to a station renames it.

caption: An offline station: no readings, said plainly
say: Click the offline station and the page says it plainly: no readings for the selected range, and the station appears to be offline. Click an online station to come back.

caption: Gear: Select parameters, one switch per reading
say: The gear opens Select parameters. Every reading is a switch: temperature, wind, humidity, rainfall, pressure, dust, particles and gases. Switch one off, and it leaves the featured area.

caption: Remove a card from the featured area
say: A card also has its own small button. Use it on barometric pressure, and the card leaves the list.

caption: Switch it on again: the card returns at the end
say: Back in Select parameters, switch it on again, and the card returns, at the end of the list.

caption: Move a card up or down, or remove it
say: Each card can also move up, move down, or leave the featured area.

caption: A reading above its limit turns red
say: A reading above its limit turns red and says Above safe limit.

caption: Reports: pick a period
say: Reports holds the Maximum Values Report. Pick a period: today, yesterday, this week, the last seven days, this month, the last thirty days, or a custom range.

caption: Peak heat index, peak wind, daily table, Excel export
say: You get the peak heat index and the peak wind speed, a daily table, and an Excel export.

caption: Settings, then Connected Products
say: Products are enabled per project, in Settings, under Connected Products.

caption: One switch per product
say: Each product has a switch. In this project Weather Station is on. Gas and Lightning are off.

caption: Switch on: the product joins the menu (not switched here)
say: Switch a product on, and it joins this project's menu with its own pages. Nothing is switched in this recording.

caption: A project with Lightning on: menu entry
say: Here is a project where Lightning is on. The menu has a Lightning entry.

caption: A project with Gas on: menu entry and status
say: And one where Gas is on. The menu shows Gas, with its status.

caption: Settings, Weather Station: the Site Safety Policy
say: Settings, Weather Station holds the Site Safety Policy. The page says it plainly: changing anything here changes when work stops, for everyone on the project.

caption: Right now: current band and the cycle in force
say: At the top, Right now shows the current band, and the work, rest and water cycle in force on site.

caption: Limits: plus and minus, count switch, 30 day chart
say: Each reading has a limit, set with plus and minus, and a switch to count it in the policy. For temperature and wind, a thirty day chart shows what the limit would have done.

caption: Heat index bands: work, rest and water
say: Below, the heat index bands. Each band has its own work, rest and water cycle.

caption: Tabs: calculation method and change history
say: Two more tabs: the heat index calculation method, and the change history.

caption: Lightning settings without a device
say: Lightning has its own settings. In this project no lightning device is provisioned yet, and the page says so.

caption: Edit alerting radii: red, yellow, all-clear delay
say: Where a device reports, the page shows its alert distances and its sensor location. Edit alerting radii opens a small form: the red distance, the yellow distance, and the all-clear delay.

caption: Set location: click the map or type coordinates
say: Set location lets you click the map or type coordinates. The location is marked Temporary.

caption: Gas: no settings page, limits are read only
say: Gas has no settings page. Its limits are shown, read only, on the Compliance page.

caption: Explore, feature, enable, configure
say: That is the setup: explore the stations, choose what to feature, enable products per project, and configure each one in Settings.
